prompt: In an anime style illustration, a bustling shipyard dock serves as the backdrop for a complex scene. On the far left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning casually against the metal railing while holding a thermos. Next to him is a rusted anchor chain coiled neatly on the wooden planks. A small gray cat sits on top of the chain, grooming its paw with intense focus. In the center foreground, a woman in blue overalls kneels beside a large open toolbox, reaching inside for a wrench. Beside her, a man in a red scarf points firmly at a blueprint spread out on a crate. The blueprint lies flat, its corners weighed down by two heavy steel bolts. To the right of the crate, a brown dog sniffs curiously at the edge of the paper, its tail wagging slightly. Behind them, a stack of three green shipping containers rises vertically, casting long shadows across the deck. A seagull perches on the topmost container, looking down at the activity below. Near the water's edge on the right, a fisherman in a striped shirt casts a line into the dark harbor water. His fishing rod bends under the tension of a catch. A young boy in a cap watches him intently, standing just behind the fisherman. Further back, a welder in a protective mask sparks fly from a torch as they work on a hull plate. Another worker in orange vest hands a clipboard to the welder, who pauses briefly to accept it. A ladder leans against the side of the ship's hull nearby, its rungs worn from use. At the base of the ladder, a pair of discarded work boots rests side by side. A pigeon pecks at crumbs near the boots, oblivious to the industrial noise. In the background, a cargo ship looms large, its hull painted white with a red stripe. A lifebuoy hangs on the ship's rail, bright orange against the white paint. There is no sun visible in the sky, suggesting an overcast day. There is no digital technology like smartphones or tablets present in the scene. There is no vegetation such as trees or grass growing on the dock.
